# Protocol recordings

`mangaprep-v1-events.jsonl` was recorded on Windows from the published mangaprep 0.9.0 executable. The input was `Mangá São José - Vol.01.cbz`, containing two copies of `e2e/manga-folder/Manga2Ink E2E/Chapter 1/001.png` under `c001 - Chapter 1/001.png` and `002.png`, and a `note.txt` entry. The invocation used `--profile KV --format epub --json-events -o "Output Library"`.

Only the recording directory and path separators were normalized to `/fixtures/`; the tool version, messages, sizes and event order are the real response. The old mangapress recording remains unchanged and checks that the new adapter rejects the old tool identity.

`mangabind-v1-chapter-versions-*.json` were recorded on Windows from a build of mangabind made from its pull request #43 (the choice among the versions of a chapter, its ADR 0028 and 0029), which was not released when they were recorded; their `tool_version` is `dev`. The input was a folder of five `.cbz` files of one page or more (`Ch.0001 (en).cbz`, `Ch.0002 (en).cbz`, two files of chapter 3 from two scan groups, `Ch.0004 (en).cbz`), run with `--dry-run --json`: with no mapping (`unresolved`), with a mapping that puts the chapters in a volume and no choice (`conflict`), and with a choice of one version (`one`, with `-chapter-labels number`), of both (`both`) and of none (`none`). Only the recording directory was normalized to `/fixtures/`. They are to be recorded again from the release that carries it, when the pin moves.
